name: Pactiv Evergreen - Kinston NC Plant
type: Manufacturing Plant / Distribution (Foodservice paper packaging; ex-Dopaco facility)

fieldNotes.location: RESOLVED. The roster geocode (35.262664, -77.581635, APPROXIMATE, moved 2103 m) landed in downtown Kinston - wrong. The facility is actually in the Lenoir County industrial park WEST of Kinston, off Enterprise Blvd near West Pharmaceutical Services and Sanderson Farms. Confirmed via property listings (LoopNet/Reonomy/clustrmaps: 1447 Enterprise Blvd, ~400,000 SF, built 1994, 23.02-acre site; clustrmaps also lists prior occupant 'Dopaco Inc' - a paper/foodservice packaging firm absorbed into the Pactiv/Reynolds family) and fresh 2026-03 Street View showing the plant on Enterprise Blvd. Locked center 35.271813, -77.667863 on the large white-roofed building.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open campus. Fresh 2026-03 Street View along Enterprise Blvd shows NO perimeter fence and NO gate - the road runs open up to the east dock apron and the front employee parking. Driveways are uncontrolled. truckGate false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth. A small structure on a grass island near the front parking entrance is a portable office/storage trailer (consistent across z20 satellite and 2026-03 Street View), not a guard booth. guardShack false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate present, so remoteGs false.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The open driveway from Enterprise Blvd to the east dock yard runs 100+ m - ample room for a 3+ truck queue inside the property.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: East building face carries a long dock bank under a canopy with many doors and trailers backed in (clear in z19-z20 satellite and 2026-03 Street View). Consistent with the 400,000 SF building footprint; estimated 25-40 doors, banded 25-50. Medium confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Paved east dock yard holds trailers and has room for a substantial drop fleet; counted ~18 trailers in imagery, capacity banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: The east paved yard functions as a trailer drop/staging lot beside the dock bank - dropYard true.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs in the corridor immediately east of the property (NE-SW) with a grade crossing on Enterprise Blvd, but no spur branches into the plant; docks are road-facing, not rail-facing. Rail not served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Lenoir County industrial park west of Kinston NC, surrounded by farm fields and a few other large industrial buildings - Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Property listings cite a 23.02-acre site; perimeter box set to match (~430 m N-S x ~350 m E-W). siteAreaAcres 23.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Open driveways; entry and exit share the access points. Lane counts are estimates.
